sys_update_xml.name: sys_script_include_e2c94e7c0f5183100847c6e530d1b234
sys_update_xml.payload:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update table="sys_script_include"><sys_script_include action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><access>public</access><active>true</active><api_name>x_1925848_empcon_0.OnboardingUtils</api_name><caller_access/><client_callable>false</client_callable><description>Utility functions for Employee Onboarding</description><mobile_callable>false</mobile_callable><name>OnboardingUtils</name><sandbox_callable>false</sandbox_callable><script><![CDATA[var OnboardingUtils = Class.create();
OnboardingUtils.prototype = {
    initialize: function() {
    },
	createDefaultTasks: function(employeeId) {
        var taskTypes = [
            'IT Setup',
            'HR Documentation',
            'Access Provisioning',
            'Induction'
        ];

        for (var i = 0; i < taskTypes.length; i++) {
            var task = new GlideRecord(
                'x_1925848_empcon_0_onboarding_task'
            );
            task.initialize();
            task.employee = employeeId;
            task.task_type = taskTypes[i];
            task.state = 1;
            task.short_description = taskTypes[i] + 
                ' - Onboarding Task';
            task.insert();
		}
	},

    type: 'OnboardingUtils'
};]]></script><sys_class_name>sys_script_include</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-06-03 10:33:55</sys_created_on><sys_id>e2c94e7c0f5183100847c6e530d1b234</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>OnboardingUtils</sys_name><sys_package display_value="EmpConnect" source="x_1925848_empcon_0">17f120740f5543100847c6e530d1b258</sys_package><sys_policy>read</sys_policy><sys_scope display_value="EmpConnect">17f120740f5543100847c6e530d1b258</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_script_include_e2c94e7c0f5183100847c6e530d1b234</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-06-03 10:33:55</sys_updated_on></sys_script_include></record_update>
